notes: Matches listing text and listing photo 1.jpg: one clear oval CZ in four claws (projected 228x270 px; 1.18:1 with the head tilted back, consistent with 8x6mm), one continuous oval pave halo, split shank whose two pave strands cross in a twist on each shoulder, plain polished back of band, rhodium silver tone. One ring only.

Scale OK against the lavender florets. Flat-lying buds measure 120-153 px, so at ~4mm per floret the ring's outer diameter (678 px, x471-1149) reads ~18-23mm (US 7 is ~20.5mm OD) and the stone width reads ~6.0-7.6mm (listed 6mm).
The lavender head is a short 5-whorl tip (~20mm at floret scale), shorter than the ~40mm referent. The florets are the reliable cue and they agree with the ring.
Halo and shoulder pave look granular/sugary at 3x zoom but read cleanly as pave at phone size.
Stone picks up lilac reflections (mean saturation 0.10, same as the paper) but reads clear/white.
Cream surface edge in the top-left corner (~15% x 5% of frame); frame is ~95% lilac hue.

The twist reads as a crossover on the shoulders, not the wrap/'knot' around the halo seen in the rounder listing photo 0.jpg. Accepted because the listing text specifies an oval stone in a pave halo with a twisted pave shank, and listing photo 1.jpg shows the same oval halo with a split pave shank.

Five natural digits on a left hand, seen from the back: thumb tucked behind the index finger (tip with nail in profile at ~x300,y1040), then index, middle, ring and pinky. Fingertip reach runs middle longest, index and ring similar, pinky shortest.

The ring sits at the base of the ring finger (4th digit). A dark gap separates that finger from the pinky just below the ring, and the split shank drops into that gap, so the ring wraps the finger plausibly.
No eye, brow, nose, lips, mouth or chin anywhere. The soft skin-tone band at the far right edge (x>1800, y125-525) is the out-of-focus forearm rising from the wrist. No other jewellery.
Scale OK. The stone is ~115 px across the finger against a finger width of ~300 px at the ring (~17mm), about 6.2-6.6mm. The halo (~165 px) is about one ring-finger nail width (157 px), i.e. ~10mm.

Stone long axis runs along the finger (north-south), as in listing photo 1.jpg. It looks slightly rounder here (projected ~1.1:1) because the finger recedes from the camera, which is consistent with 8x6mm.
Product matches: clear oval CZ in four claws, pave halo, two pave strands crossing on the shoulder, silver tone with warm skin reflections.
Frame reads lilac (wall and linen, ~62% lilac hue; the rest is skin).

Matches listing: one clear oval CZ in four claws (projected ~367x523 px, ~1.43:1 at this oblique angle, consistent with 8x6mm), crisp single-row bead-set pave halo, two pave strands splitting from the halo and crossing into a twist, plain polished back of band, silver tone. One ring only.

No listed scale referent in frame (macro on fine fabric). Internal proportions (head vs band) are plausible, and the fine weave (~10 px pitch next to the ring) gives no misleading size cue at phone size.
Warm cream out-of-focus bokeh fills the top-left ~20% of the frame. The frame still reads lilac (~78% lilac hue); grading can cool the blob if wanted.
Left side of the halo is soft from shallow depth of field, not melted detail.
Lilac/pink environment tint on the metal and stone (stone saturation 0.09); still reads clear CZ in rhodium silver. Alpha channel is fully opaque.

Ring lies on its side, seen through the finger hole with the head in profile at 12 o'clock: stone crown with front claws, pave halo seen edge-on, basket with triangular gallery windows (matches listing photo 1.jpg), and split shoulders with pave along the outer strand down to about 3 and 9 o'clock.

Scale is accurate. The inner hole (~358 px) equals 17.3mm (US 7), giving 20.7 px/mm. On that scale the stone is 130-134 px wide in profile (6.3-6.5mm, listed 6mm), the lavender buds are 77-100 px (3.7-4.8mm), and the flowering spike is ~874 px (~42mm, against the ~40mm referent).
Contact and shadows are consistent. Light comes from the upper left, the ring and lavender shadows fall lower right, and there is a contact shadow along the band. Nothing floats.
The band's side face shows dark and warm-pink reflection stripes, with a fine dotted texture in the dark stripe at 4x zoom (saturation <=0.23). At phone size it reads as one polished silver band.
The crossover twist is not visible from this profile angle, which is expected.
The ring takes up a small part of the frame (copy space), which is composition only. Frame is ~97% lilac hue.
